records.award_value: Up to 6 merit-based means-tested scholarships are awarded for students who wish to enrol in our: 3-year programme, which includes the Grade 10 (Sec 4) Foundation Course followed by the IB Diploma Programme,  which is valued at $215,000 or the; 2-year programme, which is solely the IB Diploma Programme, valued at $155,000. Up to 2 merit-based foreign scholarships are awarded to students who wish to enrol in the: 2-year programme, which is solely the IB Diploma Programme. The value of this award is $153,520. The scholarship award includes school fees, exam fees, school books, compulsory outdoor education trips, a laptop and school uniform. Additionally, the award also includes full board, flights and medical insurance.
records.requirements: Students wishing to apply for a Foreign Scholarship must be currently enrolled and attending a school in their respective home country. Course of Study Scholars awarded the 3-year scholarship will undertake a Foundation Course in Grade 10 (Sec 4), a one-year programme designed to provide students with the necessary fundamentals before they embark on the two-year IB Diploma Programme in Grades 11 and 12 (JC1 & 2). The two-year IB Diploma Programme is an academically challenging, rewarding and highly respected qualification, recognised by universities in Singapore and around the world. Scholars will study six subjects: three at the Higher Level and three at the Standard Level. In addition, they are required to write an Extended Essay, take the critical thinking course Theory of Knowledge and be active participants in the Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS). All of which are required elements of the IB Diploma Programme. *Bond Period There is no bond; however, Alumni Scholars are expected to be active participants in the SJI International Alumni Association and assist the school with the continued promotion of the Scholarship Programme.
